summary.headline: Astrological Codices and Chapter Lists
summary.text: Catalog entries for codex 10 continue with works on the winter tropic, horoscope calculation, seasonal hours, John Philoponus’s astrolabe, an astrological scholium, and the names of the twelve zodiac signs. Codex 11 (C 37 sup.), a sixteenth-century chartaceous manuscript, begins with confused astronomical tables and notes, followed by chapter titles from Perses the philosopher’s astrological work, including the sphere of the twelve signs, the sphere’s action and idea, and questions concerning marriages.
